A '''[[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] research station''' was located on [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was infiltrated by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Denal/Legends|Denal]], who stole the [[Radar-cloaking superweapon plans|plans]] to the [[Radar-cloaking superweapon]] that were being held there.
